Description: Unique transaction identifier (unique in the clean dataset; duplicated only in the injected duplicate rows).
Date and time the transaction was made.
Masked / tokenised card identifier. Not a real card number.
Customer identifier. Customers recur across many transactions.
Bank account linked to the card.
Transaction amount in rupees (foreign spend already converted to INR).
Currency of the amount.
Merchant identifier.
Notes: ATM rows carry the ATM operator ID.

Description: Merchant business category.
Allowed_Values_Or_Format: Grocery, Fuel, Electronics, Restaurants, Travel, E-commerce, Healthcare, Entertainment, Jewellery, ATM, Fashion, Utilities, Education, Gaming, Gift Cards, Money Transfer

Description: Country where the merchant is located.
Notes: Inconsistent spellings injected in some rows.

Description: City of the merchant, consistent with Merchant_Country.
How the transaction was made.
Whether the physical card was present.
Notes: Online = No; POS and ATM = Yes in clean data.

Description: How card details were captured.
Allowed_Values_Or_Format: Chip, Contactless, Swipe, Manual Entry, Online Authentication, ATM PIN

Description: POS / ATM terminal identifier.
Device identifier for online transactions.
Country of the IP address used for online transactions.
Customer billing country.
Domestic if Merchant_Country equals Billing_Country, otherwise International.
Authorization decision.
ISO 8583-style response code.
Allowed_Values_Or_Format: 00 Approved; 05 Do not honor; 14 Invalid card number; 51 Insufficient funds; 54 Expired card; 55 Incorrect PIN; 57 Txn not permitted; 59 Suspected fraud; 61 Exceeds limit; 62 Restricted card; 65 Activity count exceeded; 82 CVV check failed; 91 Issuer unavailable; 96 System error

Description: Average amount of the customer's previous transactions in the 30 days before this one (all attempts, approved and declined). If no prior transaction in the window, the customer's baseline average is used.
Number of the customer's transactions in the hour before this one (excludes this one).
Number of the customer's transactions in the 24 hours before this one (excludes this one).
Minutes since the customer's previous transaction. For a customer's first transaction in the dataset a simulated pre-period gap is used.
Approximate straight-line distance between this transaction's location and the previous one. Online uses the IP location; POS/ATM use the merchant city.
Merchant is on the bank's high-risk watch list (property of the merchant).
Notes: Same merchant always has the same value.

Description: Bank monitoring system flagged the transaction as suspicious at authorization time.
Notes: Alert time is not a separate column; it is the transaction time.

Description: Fraud confirmed after investigation or customer dispute (includes confirmed fraud attempts that were declined).
State of any chargeback on the transaction. Filed = raised, no merchant response yet; Pending = in representment/review; Won/Lost = resolved.
Allowed_Values_Or_Format: Filed, Pending, Won, Lost, Not Applicable
Notes: Not every fraud is charged back.

Description: Result of the bank's investigation (separate from the alert and from the chargeback).
Allowed_Values_Or_Format: Confirmed Fraud, Legitimate Transaction, Under Investigation, Not Investigated
Notes: Under Investigation rows are unresolved, so Confirmed_Fraud_Flag = No.
